description: Service de découverte (CSW) Voies navigables de France is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mongeosource.fr. Discovery service allowing access to metadata according to the CSW standard. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Discovery Service (CSW) Waterways of France" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include csw 2.0.2, "WMS", "Réseaux de transport". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
